verdict.rationale: Render's agent-related evidence describes integrations for external AI tools, not a built-in assistant. It ships an MCP server, plugins and skills for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. These let third-party agents manage Render infrastructure, but nothing in the evidence shows an AI assistant inside the Render dashboard or product itself that users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
